commit.message:
chore(release): rename ETC -> ECT to match usual parlance

Follow-up to tuxlink-b4ga (#815, merged). The low-floor build serves
EmComm Tools Community, which operators almost always shorthand as "ECT"
(or "ECT Community"). The code and docs used "ETC" (a transposition),
and the published artifact was named tuxlink_<ver>_<arch>_etc.deb — the
one name a user actually reads when downloading. Align everything on ECT
so the artifact matches how people refer to the platform.

- rename .github/workflows/etc-build.yml -> ect-build.yml (+ its paths
  self-reference and the ci.yml comment that names it)
- job ids build-etc/etc-install-test/publish-etc -> build-ect/
  ect-install-test/publish-ect; artifact tuxlink-etc-* -> tuxlink-ect-*;
  staging dir dist-etc -> dist-ect
- user-facing .deb suffix _etc.deb -> _ect.deb (the downloaded filename,
  the install-test glob, and the publish upload glob all move together)
- prose: ADR 0020, README, install.md, and workflow comments now say ECT

No required status checks reference the old job names (verified), so the
rename breaks no branch protection. Internal package name/version are
unchanged; only the filename suffix differs.

bd: tuxlink-gf35

Agent: marten-condor-badger
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
